items.title: Role of Logic in Reasoning and Decision Making

source_refs.note: Unnumbered heading Role of Logic in Reasoning and Decision Making under 2.3, with the Class Activity printed at the top of the next page (PDF 26-27, printed 22-23).

blocks.text: Logic plays an important role in reasoning and decision making. It helps computers and humans draw correct conclusions. Using logic, decisions are made based on facts and rules. It removes confusion and guesswork. Logical reasoning helps solve problems step by step. Computers use logic to choose the correct action. Logic ensures that decisions are consistent and accurate. It is used in expert systems and artificial intelligence.

blocks.title: Class Activity
blocks.text:
• Discuss how logic helps in making decisions.
• Students make simple “if-then” statements about school life.
• Example: “If it rains, then we will stay indoors.”
